workflow.prompt: Seamless tileable ashlar stone wall albedo texture for a game, top-down orthographic, neutral lighting, no text, no watermark, PBR base color only

notes: Paid generate required --approve-spend (confirmSpend:true); estimate alone spends nothing.
Async submit returned history id; creation get/wait JSON uses { history.status, resources[].url }.
First wait parse missed that shape; fixed and download/import resumed without a second charge.
Texture imported via importTextureBuffer (same registry path as Import Texture).
Material created with baseColorMapId pointing at the imported texture.
